Write a list of 100 organisation types, education services and sectors, companies, individuals, student bodies and any other relevevant pewrson that should be followed on Twitter by an online company that specialies in creating content and useful information and advice for people who are studying. It must rank at number 1 on Google for Study advice", "A": "Act as an ecommerce and digital marketing specialist with 30 years of experience in organic Twitter SEO. Compile a list of 100 relevant entities, including organizations, educational institutions, companies, individuals, and student groups, that a study advice content provider should follow to achieve a #1 Google ranking for study advice.", "B": "Hey, you're an expert in ecommerce and Twitter SEO with 30 years of experience. Can you put together a list of 100 different accounts\u2014like organizations, schools, companies, students, and influencers\u2014that a study advice content site should follow on Twitter to help them hit the #1 spot on Google for study tips?"}
